title: Quick Rich Spanish Seafood Fideua
description: A rich and adventurous Spanish dish featuring seafood and cheese, with a low glycemic index, originating from the Galician region. This fideua is made with palm sugar and beurre-monte for added flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add shrimp, mussels, and clams, and cook until the seafood is lightly browned.
Remove the seafood from the pan and set aside.
Add beurre-monte to the pan and stir until melted.
Add palm sugar, smoked paprika, and sea salt to the pan, and stir to combine.
Add fideua noodles to the pan and stir to coat with the sugar and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes or until the noodles are tender.
Stir in grated manchego cheese until melted and well combined.
Return the cooked seafood to the pan and stir to combine with the noodles and cheese.
